Big-city choices, small-business care

There's no shortage of cleaning companies in Dallas, and many maid service options are franchises with rotating crews and call centers. We're different: a small, locally owned company based just north of you in Richardson, where you can call and talk to us directly and the same cleaner comes back whenever possible.

North Dallas homes run the full range. Lake Highlands has classic 1960s and '70s ranch homes with original features and big backyards. The neighborhoods around Preston Hollow and Prestonwood have large homes with stone, marble and specialty finishes. And along the Central Expressway and LBJ corridors, there are apartments, condos and townhomes turning over all the time. We clean all of them, with the right products and the right amount of care for each.

"Everything looked spotless, organized, and professionally handled. If you want someone you can trust to keep your space looking its best, Lindsey is the one." — M. Proctor

How we help Dallas homeowners and renters

  • Deep cleaning — baseboard cleaning, ceiling fans, cabinet cleaning on fronts and handles (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), detailed bathroom cleaning down to the grout, and appliance cleaning inside the oven and fridge. Ideal before the holidays, before hosting, or as a first visit.
  • Recurring cleaning — best value. Weekly, every other week or monthly at our reduced recurring rate.
  • Move-in / move-out cleaning — for apartments, condos and houses changing hands.
  • Standard cleaning — reliable, thorough essentials.
  • Pet-friendly house cleaning — extra attention on dog and cat hair, with eco-friendly, pet-safe products.

Also available: apartment and condo cleaning · one-time cleaning · Airbnb cleaning · post-construction cleaning · office cleaning

Careful with stone, marble and wood

Natural stone counters, marble bathrooms and hardwood floors look incredible when they're cared for properly — and can be damaged by the wrong cleaner. We use professional-grade, eco-conscious products and are glad to use your preferred stone or wood cleaner instead. Leave it out and note it in your booking, and we'll follow your instructions.

What every visit covers

  • Kitchen counters, island, backsplash, sink, stovetop, appliance exteriors and microwave
  • Bathrooms: toilets, tubs, showers, glass, mirrors, vanities and fixtures
  • Dusting throughout, mirrors and glass surfaces
  • All floors vacuumed and mopped
  • Beds made and trash emptied
  • Deep cleans add: spot-cleaned baseboards, ceiling fans, blinds, switch plates, window sills, cabinet fronts (plus the inside of cabinets if they're empty), soap scum and grout, and inside the oven and fridge; move-in/move-out cleans also add door frames, inside vanities and closet shelving
  • Standard clean add-ons: inside oven, inside refrigerator, interior windows, laundry

Which parts of Dallas do you serve?

North Dallas and Lake Highlands are right next to our Richardson base, and we clean all over the city too, including Lakewood, Uptown, Preston Hollow, Oak Lawn and Bishop Arts. We also serve the rest of Dallas–Fort Worth. Enter your address in the instant quote to confirm, or call (469) 210-8005.

Do you clean apartments and condos?

Yes. Just include building access or parking instructions in your booking notes.

Can I keep the same cleaner?

We work hard to send the same person to every recurring client.
